policy: Fail closed on official-source conflicts, AI ineligibility, assignment to another contributor, broken withdrawals, legal/account gates, or spend requirements. Advertised reward is never treated as cash until payout is independently verified.

notes: Zero-stake worker submissions may execute when task state and worker action are verified immediately before submission
Documented email fallback is acceptable when GitHub integration cannot comment
Do not book revenue until wallet proof
Seller offer can be public and matched but buyer currently initiates the deal
Registration creates/signs a new Solana identity and API account
Platform use/wallet connection is subject to service terms
Execute only if current issue/PR competition remains acceptable
Official source currently restricts submissions to human contributors
Recent public evidence shows accrued reward withdrawal/payout path is not reliably realizable
Reject closed/stale issues and any bounty already assigned to another contributor
Generic GitHub discovery requires issue-level proof of funding, eligibility, assignment status and payout route before execution
